Description: CR-22 (ASR rules in audit mode on Windows servers) scenarios, synthetic names and IDs. Servers is EW.4-SERVERS as collector 1.17.0 writes it: srv-app01 with no rule configured, srv-sql01 with two rules already configured (in Block on the server), the domain controller dc01, srv-legacy01 whose Microsoft Defender Antivirus is in Passive mode (EW.4-AVMODE), srv-files01 with cloud-delivered protection Off, srv-new01 seen but not onboarded, and srv-web01 with no configuration assessment and not yet managed by security settings management (LIC.4-DEVICES). Events is EW.5. A scenario with its own Servers replaces them.
